title: AgentAdapter-TimesFM: Agentic Residual Adapters for Scientific Time-Series Forecasting

contributions.purpose: 用智能体自动选残差适配器增强 TimesFM
contributions.mechanism: 冻结 TimesFM 骨干 + 小残差适配器(线性去趋势+偏置、时序 CNN、多周期外生 Fourier EXO-mp);designer/coder/runner/analyst 多智能体环自动提案-执行-分析
contributions.evaluation: 3 数据集多 horizon,单 GPU Colab
contributions.domain: 科学时间序列预测 / 基础模型适配
contributions.source_quote: We present AgentAdapter-TimesFM, a lightweight agentic framework that augments a frozen TimesFM backbone with small residual adapters selected through a multi-agent workflow.

contributions.purpose: 如实报告适配器多为无效(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: 逐数据集-horizon 比 MAE 相对基线变化
contributions.evaluation: 仅 EXO-mp 在 ECL H=168 降 MAE 0.78%;其余中性或更差:Niño3.4 6M +45.0%、ETTm1 336 +2.88%、ECL24 +0.25%;线性/TCN 全程中性或负
contributions.source_quote: adapters yield dataset- and horizon-dependent effects: on the Electricity Load dataset at a weekly horizon (H=168), EXO-mp reduces MAE by about 0.78%, while improvements are neutral or negative elsewhere

contributions.mechanism: 发布代码/配置/运行日志(表图由 JSONL 日志直接生成)
contributions.source_quote: we release the codebase, configuration files, and run logs that generate all tables and figures.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We build on the official TimesFM 2.0 (500M) checkpoint [1]. A lightweight wrapper provides a [frozen backbone].

notes: 诚实负结果论文,checklist 明确"We present negative results where adapters [fail]"。重 trade-off:6 个数据集-horizon 组合 5 个中性/更差,最差 Niño3.4 6M MAE +45%;唯一稳定增益 EXO-mp ECL168 仅 -0.78%。算力受限单 GPU Colab,概率指标(CRPS 等)未系统报告。AI 参与度 checklist 多为 C/D(mostly AI/AI-generated)。无数据红旗。reject。
